title: A Stack card can no longer be played into a lane Slashed Dream voided
notes: zones::accepts_stack_card refuses a void zone (R4221001, R3554002): a Stack play is offered no zone of the slash lane, and an Animated on your turn card whose home the slash voided stays a Unit at cleanup instead of being lost. classify names the Stack cards whose play lists change on a slashed board.

player.title: Fixes on a board Slashed Dream cut
fixes: A Stack card is no longer offered the lane Slashed Dream Cries in Red voided as a place to play it.
An Animated on your turn card whose home zone Slashed Dream voided now stays a Unit where it stands at the end of your turn, rather than vanishing.
